# tNR chi-squared vs shared coadded reference, with expected spread
# var    = dR^2 + s dR_ref^2, s = -1 inside the reference block else +1
# chi2   = mean((R-R_ref)^2 / var)                      (baseline 1)
# snr    = sqrt(max(0, chi2-1)) = RMS change / RMS noise
